name: Suprajit Engineering Ltd
title: Suprajit Engineering Ltd-$ - 532509 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Restructuring-led margin story: SCS turned EBITDA positive in Q4 FY26 and management guides FY27 consolidated EBITDA margin 12-13.5% with GCM at 10-12%, but tariff leakage and Middle East commodity risk are unresolved.

utilisation.quote: we operate mostly in one shift. So, I don't think there is an issue at all.

capex.quote: We have a CAPEX allocated for about INR 200 crores.

triggers.label: FY27 EBITDA margin 12-13.5%
triggers.quote: Consolidated EBITDA, we are guiding for a 12 % to 13.5% range for the year.

triggers.label: Commodity costs passed to customers
triggers.quote: we will be pushing our customers for compensation for commodity prices, which have increased.

triggers.label: SCD capacity expansion planned
triggers.quote: SCD is also planning a significant capacity expansion to take care of this new business win expected.

triggers.label: Halogen lamp rival insolvent
triggers.quote: one of the world's largest halogen lamp manufacturers – in fact, the largest halogen lamp manufacturer has declared insolvency.

guidance.quote: from a group revenue standpoint, we see and expect a double-digit growth this year.
Consolidated EBITDA, we are guiding for a 12 % to 13.5% range for the year.
we are expecting that this year to the EBITDA margin to be 10% to 12%.
The margins at ICM are expected to be stable.
We have a CAPEX allocated for about INR 200 crores.

prior_guidance_check.quote: With this will turn EBITDA positive in Q4. As you would note from the press release, this has been achieved.

red_flags.label: Unrecoverable tariffs permanent in material cost
red_flags.quote: that permanently will be there in our material cost itself.

red_flags.label: Phoenix Lamps margin down ~200bps
red_flags.quote: you are right about 200 basis point drop in the margin is very true.

red_flags.label: PLD revenue declined, EBITDA down
red_flags.quote: The revenues declined by around 3% and EBITDA also declined.

evasions.quote: we don't really talk about an order book as such
I will have to check this.

evasions.topic: Electronics margin outlook beyond one year
evasions.quote: We can only comment for one year
